Test 9

भूमिकाएँ

1. Maya - 9 years, a girl in a red frock
2. Kabir - 12 years, a boy in a blue hoodie
3. Grandpa - 70 years, white kurta and glasses

लोकेशन

1. the street - wet road, puddles, parked cars

सामान

1. umbrella - a big yellow umbrella

---

सीन 1: the street

Location: the street
Time: Evening

[It starts raining heavily.]

Kabir [shouting] - «Run, Grandpa, run!»

[Grandpa opens the yellow umbrella.]

Grandpa [laughing] - “Why run? Enjoy the rain!”
